t: What Thorium Molten Salt Reactors (MSRs) Is
title: What Thorium Molten Salt Reactors (MSRs) Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Thorium molten salt reactors dissolve nuclear fuel in hot liquid salt: the fuel is the coolant, the reactor runs at atmospheric pressure, and thorium — 4x more abundant than uranium — breeds its own fissile fuel while burning long-lived waste. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Thorium Molten Salt Reactors (MSRs): start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Thorium Molten Salt Reactors (MSRs) in one line: Thorium molten salt reactors dissolve nuclear fuel in hot liquid salt: the fuel is the coolant, the reactor runs at atmospheric pressure, and thorium — 4x more abundant than uranium — breeds its own fissile fuel while burning long-lived waste.
Why it matters: Thorium MSRs promise walk-away-safe nuclear with abundant fuel and minimal long-lived waste..
Where it is used: baseload power, industrial heat, waste burning, remote power..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
